source_integrity_findings: The abstract reports a paired t-test with n=8 for the -6.14 AMISOS-R change, whereas the main Results text and Table 2 identify that completer analysis as n=7; the separate LOCF analysis is n=8 with mean change -5.37.
Results prose says SCL-90 mean scores decreased by 33%, but Table 2 means 172.83 to 154.83 imply an approximate 10.4% decrease. The table values are preserved without adopting the 33% claim.

The paper states that no adverse events were reported while also describing treatment-emergent suicidal ideation and other side effects; these statements are preserved as a source-integrity tension rather than reconciled into a stronger safety claim.
extraction_limitations: The supplementary appendix mentioned for AMISOS-R was not present in the retrieved packet and therefore was not extracted.
This uncontrolled pilot case series is small and heterogeneous; ATOM records reported findings and limitations without upgrading causal inference.

The article uses the term intention-to-treat for an eight-person treated-population LOCF analysis rather than all ten baseline-included participants; the source terminology is preserved in tags/method text while the population is explicitly labeled as treated participants.
